title: Precision of Cup Positioning Using a Novel Computed Tomography Based Navigation System in Total Hip Arthroplasty
summary: Full MDPI text reviewed in Chrome: a CT-based AI navigation platform uses segmentation, landmark identification, 3D reconstruction and registration to support hip-cup placement. Precision was checked in 15 cadaver inter-rater measurements and 18 patient surgeries by comparing navigation display with postoperative CT; reported mean placement errors were small. Approve as a bounded surgical-navigation measurement result, not evidence of improved patient outcomes. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
